alternate_titles: Apostolic Exhortation for the Right Ordering and Development of Devotion to the Blessed Virgin Mary
work.author: Pope Paul VI
work.description: The apostolic exhortation of 2 February 1974 on the renewal of Marian devotion after the Second Vatican Council. Sections 42-55 treat the Rosary: its Gospel character, elements, contemplative soul, relation to the liturgy, family recitation, and the freedom of the faithful. The text is numbered in 58 sections, the locus system used here.
work.title: Marialis cultus
